svg.title: Your data model lives in the repo, as DBML. The canvas is a view over it.
svg.desc: Left: the VS Code Explorer for a dbt project. The .erd-studio folder (design) holds the logical model as DBML, in a silver layer folder: the orders diagram in diagrams/orders.dbml, the relationships in relationships/silver.dbml, and one file per table in tables/silver (dim_customer.dbml, fct_order.dbml), plus layers.json. The models and target folders (code and warehouse) hold the dbt SQL, schema.yml, catalog.json and manifest.json. The silver layer's DBML files render as the ERD Studio Logical canvas (dim_customer joined one to many to fct_order, with order_total), and canvas edits save back to them. Its toolbar offers Compare with dbt. The dbt project derives the read-only Physical canvas, never written to disk, here comparing with the design (Stop comparing). Comparing the two finds two differences: order_amt is only in the warehouse and order_total only in the design, because the column was renamed in the SQL. The fix is a one-line change to fct_order.dbml in the same pull request.
